otherProperties.description: Maps a logical path prefix to a host directory for open_file(), compile_from_file(), and eval_from_file(). The property name is the prefix: a logical path must equal the property name or begin with the property name followed by '/'. Among matching prefixes, the longest wins (so property 'includes' is preferred over 'include' for path 'includes/a.as'). The property value is a template for the host directory, evaluated when the application conf is processed (plain strings are unchanged; substitutions such as environment:: may be used). The evaluated path is resolved to a full path at that time (relative paths use the process current working directory). The resolved host path must remain under that directory after canonicalization; path segments of '..' and other escapes are rejected. Example: property 'my' with value '/temp/my' allows open_file('s1', 'my/xyz', 'w') to open host file '/temp/my/xyz' when that path stays under '/temp/my'.
